classification.difficultyReason: Choose percentages and reverse their fraction operations to construct five valid percentage–whole pairs for each target; the choices are open, but benchmark percentages provide a routine strategy.

content.prompt: Fill in the missing numbers in at least 5 ways.

answer.worked:
Five possible completions, using benchmark percentages:
$$\begin{align*}50\%\text{ of }60&=60\div2=30\\25\%\text{ of }120&=120\div4=30\\10\%\text{ of }300&=300\div10=30\\20\%\text{ of }150&=150\div5=30\\5\%\text{ of }600&=600\div20=30\end{align*}$$
Other valid pairs are possible.

Five possible completions, using benchmark percentages:
$$\begin{align*}50\%\text{ of }54&=54\div2=27\\25\%\text{ of }108&=108\div4=27\\10\%\text{ of }270&=270\div10=27\\20\%\text{ of }135&=135\div5=27\\5\%\text{ of }540&=540\div20=27\end{align*}$$
Other valid pairs are possible.
